      Heading "Related stories" level=3
      each r in filter(stories,s=>s.id!=pickedId)

      IconButton "{r}" animate=pop onTap={reactions=with(reactions,string(pickedId)+r,coalesce(get(reactions,string(pickedId)+r),0)+1); close}

### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/music-player.txt ### Player
state current="t1" persist
state pos=0 persist
state playing=false
state speed=1
state repeat="off"
state shuffleOn=false
state volume=70 persist
state sheet="full"
App
  Main
    Nav
      IconButton "keyboard_arrow_down" onTap={go library}
      Text.strong "Now playing"
      IconButton "queue_music" onTap={go queue}
    Row gap=48 pad=32 center middle
      AlbumCover hue={find(albums,a=>a.id==find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).album).hue} w=420 h=420 radius=32 glow={playing} animate={playing?"pulse":""}
      Column grow gap=16 maxw=480
        Column gap=4
          Heading "{find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).title}" level=1
          Text.muted "{find(albums,a=>a.id==find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).album).artist}"
        Column gap=4
          Slider @pos min=0 max={find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).len} step=1 keys="left:-5,right:+5,home:0" aria="Seek"
          Row between
            Text.small "{duration(pos)}"
            Text.small "-{duration(find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).len-pos)}"
        Row gap=16 center middle
          IconButton "shuffle" selected={shuffleOn} onTap={shuffleOn=!shuffleOn}
          IconButton "skip_previous" size=large onTap={emit previous}
          IconButton.primary "{playing?'pause':'play_arrow'}" size=xlarge onTap={playing=!playing}
          IconButton "skip_next" size=large onTap={emit next}
          IconButton "{repeat=='one'?'repeat_one':'repeat'}" selected={repeat!="off"} onTap={repeat=repeat=="off"?"all":(repeat=="all"?"one":"off")}
        Row gap=12 middle
          Text.muted "Speed"
          SegmentedButton @speed items=[0.75,1,1.25,1.5]
        Row gap=12 middle
          Icon "volume_down"
          Slider grow @volume min=0 max=100 keys="up:+5,down:-5" aria="Volume"
          Icon "volume_up"
        Lyrics lines={lyrics[current]} time={pos} @pos onSeek={pos=result} h=200 highlight=#FFF5A524
    Sheet#miniPlayer "" snap=["mini","full"] @sheet draggable show=phone
      Row gap=12 middle
        AlbumCover hue={find(albums,a=>a.id==find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).album).hue} size=48 radius=10
        Text.strong grow "{find(tracks,t=>t.id==current).title}"
        IconButton.primary "{playing?'pause':'play_arrow'}" onTap={playing=!playing}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/2026-11-16-sonnet/answers/photo-library.txt ### Viewer
state info=false
state zoom=1
state compare=false
state at=0
Page
  Stack
    Zoomable @zoom pinch wheel doubleTap pan onSwipeLeft={at=min(at+1,59)} onSwipeRight={at=max(at-1,0)} onDragDown={go photos} onKey="Escape" onEscape={go photos}
      Image "{photos[at].url}" fit=contain
    Row between pad=16 top
      IconButton "close" onTap={go photos}
      Text.muted "{at+1} of {length(photos)}"
      Row gap=8
        IconButton "info" onTap={info=!info; open infoSheet}
        IconButton "favorite" selected={contains(favs,photos[at].id)} onTap={favs=contains(favs,photos[at].id)?without(favs,photos[at].id):append(favs,photos[at].id)}
        IconButton "tune" onTap={go edit}
        IconButton "delete" onTap={open confirmOne}
    IconButton "chevron_left" onTap={at=max(at-1,0)} shortcut="ArrowLeft"
    IconButton "chevron_right" onTap={at=min(at+1,59)} shortcut="ArrowRight"
    ThumbnailStrip photos={photos} @at bottom h=64 gap=2
  Sheet#infoSheet "Info" right
    Column gap=12 pad=16
      Text.strong "{formatDate(photos[at].date,"MMM d, yyyy")}"
      Row gap=8
        Icon "place"
        Text "{photos[at].place}"
      Row gap=8
        Icon "storage"
        Text "{photos[at].size}"
      Row gap=8 wrap
        each t in photos[at].tags
          Chip "{t}" onTap={q=t; go search}
  Dialog#confirmOne "Delete this picture?" "It moves to Recently deleted."
    Row end gap=8
      Button.ghost "Cancel" onTap={close}
      Button.destructive "Delete" onTap={photos=updateWhere(photos,p=>p.id==photos[at].id,p=>with(p,"deleted",true)); close; go photos}
### tool/vocabulary/corpus/b07/answers/one-handed-reach.txt ### Notes
state pulled=false
state q=""
state scale=100
state notes=[{"id":"n1","title":"Groceries for Sunday","body":"Oat milk, lemons, basil, fresh pasta","when":"Today","pinned":true},{"id":"n2","title":"Call the dentist","body":"Ask about the 9:30 slot on Thursday","when":"Today","pinned":false},{"id":"n3","title":"Trip ideas","body":"Lisbon in March, Kyoto in the autumn","when":"Yesterday","pinned":false},{"id":"n4","title":"Book list","body":"The Overstory, Piranesi, Braiding Sweetgrass","when":"Mon","pinned":false},{"id":"n5","title":"Standup notes","body":"Ship the onboarding fix, review Priya's PR","when":"Mon","pinned":false},{"id":"n6","title":"Gift for Mum","body":"Ceramic planter, the green one from the market","when":"Sun","pinned":false}]
App scale={scale/100} onEdgeSwipeRight={go reach} onEdgeSwipeLeft={go note}
  Main
    ListView pulldown={pulled} onPullDown={pulled=true} onPullUp={pulled=false} gap=8 pad=16
      Spacer h={pulled ? 320 : 0}
      each n in filter(notes, x=>contains(lower(x.title), lower(q)))
        Card gap=4 onTap={go note} animate=fade stagger=40
          Row between
            Text.strong "{n.title}"
            if n.pinned
              Icon "push_pin"
          Text.muted "{n.body}"
          Text.caption "{n.when}"
    Footer
      Row between pad=8
        IconButton "search" tooltip="Search" onTap={open searchSheet}
        IconButton "sort" tooltip="Sort" onTap={notes=sortBy(notes, x=>x.title)}
        Button "New note" icon="add" onTap={go note}
        IconButton "map" tooltip="Reach map" onTap={go reach}
        IconButton "tune" tooltip="Screen size" onTap={go scaling}
  Sheet#searchSheet
    Input "Search notes" @q
    Row gap=8
      Button.outline "Clear" onTap={q=""}
      Button "Done" onTap={close}
  Sheet#pulledTitle "Thumbzone" pulled
    Text.muted "{length(notes)} notes"
